$comment: Accepted dependency and container image risks for CI vulnerability scans (scripts/audit-dependencies.mjs and scripts/audit-container-image.mjs). See the 'Dependency Vulnerability Policy' section in SECURITY.md. Suppressions are temporary, must carry an explicit justification, and expire — adding an entry here does NOT silence new advisories.

suppressions.reason: DeepmergeTS stack exhaustion (CWE-674) only triggers on recursive object graphs, which the Prisma CLI never feeds into deepmerge; no patched deepmerge-ts >= 8.0.0 is published and @prisma/config (npm latest) still pins 7.1.5, so no fix is available upstream. Dev/tooling-only exposure — not reachable from the app runtime.
Transitive path of GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx (deepmerge-ts 7.1.5). Same justification: Prisma CLI config merging, dev tooling only, no upstream fix yet.

containerSuppressions.$comment: Document accepted container OS-package or bundled-binary CVEs here. Each entry must provide 'id' (or 'cve'/'package'), 'reason', and 'expires'.
